name: Anhui Zhongding Sealing Parts Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Zhongding Sealing Parts Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of hydraulic and pneumatic seals and automotive non-tire rubber products in China and internationally. It offers sealing system, including drivetrain, chassis, powertrain, electrical, three-electrical, and brake systems; fluid and intelligent thermal management systems; intelligent suspension system, such as air suspension and road preview systems; and anti-vibration, noise reduction, and intelligent chassis systems comprising body system and electric power steering.
